definitions.simple: A six-membered ring compound containing carbon and two nitrogen atoms. Cytosine and thymine are examples of pyrimidine-based DNA bases.
definitions.scientific: Pyrimidine (1,3-diazine) is a six-membered aromatic heterocycle containing nitrogen atoms at ring positions 1 and 3. Substituted pyrimidines include the nucleobases cytosine and thymine.
